subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 12 Mathematics: Precalculus & Advanced Topics
overview: Grade 12 Mathematics delivers advanced mathematical preparation, rigorous logical deduction, and complex modeling across algebraic, geometric, trigonometric, and analytical domains.
competencies: Construct formal deductive arguments, proofs, and mathematical models to solve real-world problems.
Analyze functions, coordinate systems, and algebraic structures with computational accuracy.
Apply advanced formulas, theorems, and mathematical transformations.
Communicate mathematical reasoning fluently using precise symbolic notation and graphical representations.

modules.title: Complex Numbers and Vectors in the Plane
modules.description: Representing complex numbers in polar form, De Moivre's theorem, vector operations (addition, scalar multiplication, dot product).

topics.title: Polar Coordinates and Complex Polar Form
topics.description: Converting between rectangular and polar coordinates (r, theta) and computing products/powers using De Moivre's theorem.

topics.title: Vectors: Magnitude, Direction and Dot Products
topics.description: Performing vector addition, calculating magnitude, direction angles, and applying the dot product to find angle between vectors.

modules.title: Trigonometry: Advanced Identities and Analytical Modeling
modules.description: Verifying sum and difference formulas, double-angle and half-angle identities, and solving complex trigonometric equations.

topics.title: Sum, Difference, and Double-Angle Identities
topics.description: Proving and applying analytic trigonometric identities to simplify expressions and solve equations.

topics.title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
topics.description: Restricting domains to define arcsin, arccos, and arctan, and evaluating composite expressions.

modules.title: Parametric Equations, Polar Graphs & Conic Sections
modules.description: Graphing parametric curve trajectories, graphing polar curves (limacons, rose curves), and analyzing ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas.

topics.title: Parametric Equations and Motion Over Time
topics.description: Eliminating the parameter t to model projectile motion and simultaneous object paths.

topics.title: Conic Sections: Ellipses, Hyperbolas and Parabolas
topics.description: Deriving standard equations of conics, identifying foci, vertices, and asymptotes.

modules.title: Limits, Sequences, Series and Introduction to Calculus
modules.description: Evaluating limits algebraically and graphically, finding sums of infinite geometric series, and computing difference quotients.

topics.title: Limits and Continuity
topics.description: Evaluating one-sided and two-sided limits as x approaches a value or infinity, identifying points of discontinuity.

topics.title: Difference Quotients and the Concept of the Derivative
topics.description: Computing average rates of change and taking the limit of difference quotients to introduce instantaneous velocity.
